lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno copied every move
The cat would make, he found the groove!
Kiki giggled, look at you,
A copycat copies what others do!
[chorus]
Copycat, copycat,
Doing this and doing that!
Copycat, copycat,
Copying all the moves of the cat!
[verse]
It means someone who copies you,
Says your words and does it too,
It's fine to learn from friends, it's true,
But be yourself, there's only you!
[chorus]
Copycat, copycat,
Doing this and doing that!
Copycat, copycat,
Be yourself, just like that!
[outro]
So if someone copies you flat,
Smile and say, you copycat!
